scripts.prismixed: cat ./prisma/models/*.prisma > ./prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma validate --config=prisma.config.ts && npx prisma format --config=prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:empty: npm run prismixed && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --config=prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run prismixed && npx prisma migrate dev --config=prisma.config.ts && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm run prismixed && npx prisma migrate deploy --config=prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:push: npm run prismixed && npx prisma db push --config=prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:generate: npm run prismixed && npx prisma generate --config=prisma.config.ts --sql
scripts.db:generate:dev: npm run prismixed && npx prisma generate --config=prisma.config.ts --sql --watch
